crash_definition: At least 20% peak-to-trough decline, computed separately for each index and data frequency; these are episodes in the supplied series, not a complete list of all world financial crises.

nasdaq100_feature_targets.target_next_close_up: next recorded daily close exceeds current close
nasdaq100_feature_targets.target_next20d_drawdown10pct: at least one close during the next 20 sessions is 10% or more below current close
